mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: CommonDataMapper.selectAuthUserList */ t1.aut_oid, t1.aut_id, t1.aut_nm FROM common.tb_com_auth t1 INNER JOIN common.tb_com_authusermap t2 ON t1.aut_oid = t2.aut_oid WHERE t1.use_yn = 'Y' AND t1.pltfrm_id = #{pltfrmId} AND t2.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CommonDataMapper.selectAuthUserCount */ COUNT (DISTINCT t2.user_id) FROM common.tb_com_auth t1 INNER JOIN common.tb_com_authusermap t2 ON t1.aut_oid = t2.aut_oid WHERE t1.use_yn = 'Y' AND t1.pltfrm_id = #{pltfrmId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CommonDataMapper.selectAuthUserList */ DISTINCT t2.user_id FROM common.tb_com_auth t1 INNER JOIN common.tb_com_authusermap t2 ON t1.aut_oid = t2.aut_oid WHERE t1.use_yn = 'Y' AND t1.pltfrm_id = #{pltfrmId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CommonDataMapper.selectDistinctAuthApiUrlList */ DISTINCT t1.aut_oid, t4.api_url, t4.mthd_cd FROM common.tb_com_auth t1 INNER JOIN common.tb_com_authapimap t2 ON t1.aut_oid = t2.aut_oid INNER JOIN common.tb_com_apigroup t3 ON t2.api_grp_oid = t3.api_grp_oid INNER JOIN common.tb_com_api t4 ON t3.api_grp_oid = t4.api_grp_oid WHERE t1.use_yn = 'Y' AND t3.pltfrm_id = #{pltfrmId} AND t3.use_yn = 'Y' AND t4.use_yn = 'Y'
